OLWC_WarcasketHelmet_Overlord.descriptio.english:
Specialized spacer-tech warcasket helmet with standard protection, equipped with a command visor for the pilot's mechlink.

A 10th-generation design from the government program that rebuilt captured pirate rigs around its own power armor and gave them to veterans who could no longer serve any other way. The Overlord was its rig for veteran mechanitors, who would command their own mechs in the field rather than join a squad.

The Overlord series is meant for a mechanitor who goes into battle alone, with only their mechs beside them. The core in the shell holds only a few charges and recharges very slowly, so they are best saved for the mechs that matter most. The shoulders and helmet carry processors that support the pilot's mechlink, and the arms are left free for smithing and hacking. Because the plating is far tougher than a mechanitor's usual armor, the pilot can lead from the front line rather than from behind the mechs.

OLWC_WarcasketHelmet_Overlord.shortDescr.english: Specialized spacer-tech warcasket helmet with standard protection, equipped with a command visor for the pilot's mechlink.

OLWC_WarcasketTrait_Overlord.degreeDatas.english: {PAWN_nameDef} is entombed in a warcasket. No amount of pain will have an effect on {PAWN_objective}, and {PAWN_pronoun} can never go into a pain shock or drop unconscious due to pain. Because of how bulky the armor is and how much energy it takes to use it, {PAWN_nameDef} is not capable of most work, but can still do smithing and hacking.

OLWC_ResurrectMech.description.english: Resurrect a recently killed mechanoid by externally supercharging its self-repair processes. The mech will come back with some but not all of its wounds healed. Each resurrection costs some of the armor's charges, and heavier mechs cost more.
